clauses.text: The provisions of Chapter I to Chapte XXIII shall come into force on the day appointed by th President by Proclamation.

Parliament shall meet on the day so appointed and the President may, in such Proclamation, specify th time at which Parliament shall so meet. Devo Vassatukalena sassasampattihetu ca phito bhavatu loko ca raja bhavatu dhammiko SIDDHIRASTU titution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
